description: A government credit scheme that channels collateral-free micro-loans (Shishu, Kishore, Tarun categories) through banks and NBFCs for small and micro business needs such as working capital or equipment.
why_relevant: Micro-enterprise credit can be relevant for working capital, equipment, or business expansion needs.
eligibility_note: Eligibility, loan category (Shishu/Kishore/Tarun), lender terms and current limits must be verified with a participating bank or NBFC.

description: The official government registration for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs), based on self-declared investment and turnover figures.
why_relevant: Formal MSME registration can help a qualifying micro enterprise access priority-sector credit, government tenders, and other MSME benefits.
eligibility_note: Check whether your enterprise qualifies under current MSME investment/turnover limits and complete registration through the official portal using Aadhaar and PAN.

description: A micro-credit facility for street vendors, offering small working-capital loans with incentives for timely repayment and digital transactions.
why_relevant: Relevant if the business is a street-vending activity rather than a fixed retail shop.
eligibility_note: Vendor certificate/ID from the local urban local body and current lending conditions apply.

description: A digital market-access and enablement initiative under the MSME RAMP programme to help small enterprises connect with e-commerce and digital B2B/B2C channels.
why_relevant: Can be relevant to eligible micro and small enterprises seeking digital commerce or market-access support.
eligibility_note: Check current participation rules, onboarding route and availability, which may vary by state and sector.

target_location: All India, with a rural/urban project split
description: A credit-linked subsidy scheme administered by KVIC to help set up new micro-enterprises, combining a bank loan with a government subsidy component.
why_relevant: Can be relevant for a new project or a significant expansion of an existing micro-enterprise, particularly in rural and semi-urban areas.
eligibility_note: Applies mainly to new units meeting project-cost and promoter-eligibility conditions; existing, already-running businesses should check applicability carefully.

description: A bank-loan facility encouraging greenfield enterprises by women and SC/ST entrepreneurs, with loans typically between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore.
why_relevant: Potentially relevant for a woman entrepreneur or SC/ST entrepreneur planning a new greenfield business or a significant new unit.
eligibility_note: Loan sizes are larger than typical micro-enterprise needs; check whether the business qualifies as a greenfield project under current guidelines.

scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
description: A credit-guarantee mechanism that allows banks and NBFCs to extend collateral-free loans to eligible micro and small enterprises.
why_relevant: May help a business access a collateral-free loan through a participating lender, reducing the need for security/collateral.
eligibility_note: The guarantee is availed by the lending bank, not applied for directly by the business; ask your bank whether a proposed loan can be covered under CGTMSE.
